# consumer — the smallest project that links doppler

## Get the code

The files are listed [at the bottom of this page](#the-files). The tabs there show the project on the development branch; this fetches the project's folder from the latest release, which can differ from them until the next release:

<!-- doc-version:start -->

<!-- docs-snippet: no-exec=downloads the release tarball; the clean-container walk (tests/install) runs it for real -->
```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/doppler-dsp/doppler/archive/refs/tags/v0.81.0.tar.gz \
  | tar -xz --strip-components=2 doppler-0.81.0/example-projects/consumer
```

Or browse [`example-projects/consumer/`](https://github.com/doppler-dsp/doppler/tree/v0.81.0/example-projects/consumer).
